description.text: Nutrition & Biological Technology is taught with English. After graduation, Doctoral Degree is awarded. Main courses:biochemistry,medical microbiology,amynology,physiology,pathology,diagnostics andNutrition and food hygiene. Laboratory Equipment

duration.text: The Nutrition and Biological Technology at Capital Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two references From persons of at least associate professor status (only for postgraduates)

requirements.text: 1、Non-Chinese nationals in good health 2、Graduated from an institution equal to Chinese senior high school (for undergraduate applicants) 3、Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification (for postgraduate applicants)
